story.title: From the Heart of Palestine, to Every Home
story.body: HATTAH was born from a longing for an unforgettable land, and a sincere wish to keep the details of Palestinian heritage alive in every home and every heart. Every embroidered stitch, every thread, every symbol we bring to you tells a story of patience, beauty, and an identity that has never changed. We work from Turkey with skilled Palestinian hands, to bring you authentic pieces that carry the spirit of the land wherever you are.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Quick answers about ordering and products from HATTAH.

items.q: What is HATTAH and where are you based?
items.a: HATTAH (حَطّة) is an online store based in Istanbul offering Palestinian and Gazan heritage products such as hoodies, tatreez embroidery, artwork, medallions and homemade food. We do not have a public shop for walk-ins; we work through the online store and WhatsApp.

items.q: How do I order from HATTAH?
items.a: Choose a product in the store, add it to your cart and send the order on WhatsApp in one tap, or message us directly on WhatsApp at {phone} with the product you want.

items.q: What sizes are available for the hoodies?
items.a: Available sizes are listed on each product page. If you need help choosing a size, message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I order a custom-design hoodie?
items.a: Yes. Send us your idea on WhatsApp and we will confirm whether it can be made, the price and the preparation time.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We confirm the available payment methods with you on WhatsApp when the order is confirmed.
Hoodies with heritage designs, Palestinian tatreez embroidery, artwork, medallions and necklaces, homemade Palestinian food and other heritage gifts.

legal.privacyLead: This policy explains how HATTAH handles your data when you browse the site or order through WhatsApp.

privacySections.p: HATTAH (حَطّة) is an online store based in Istanbul, Türkiye, selling Palestinian heritage products. Contact: hattah.store.co@gmail.com or WhatsApp +90 552 998 71 12.

The site has no user accounts or sign-up forms. When you order on WhatsApp you give us your name, phone number, address and order details; we use them only to prepare, complete and follow up on your order. Your browser stores your cart and theme/sound preferences locally — these are not sent to us.
We use order data to prepare and complete your order and for after-sales support. We do not sell your data or share it for advertising.

The site is hosted on Vercel and product data is stored in Supabase. Orders are received through WhatsApp (Meta). We also publish store content on our Facebook Page and Instagram account. These services are governed by their own policies.

We use an internal automated tool to publish our own product photos and offers to the HATTAH Facebook Page and the store's Instagram account only. The tool posts our content; it does not access visitors' accounts or personal data and does not collect any data about our followers.
We keep order data for as long as needed to fulfil orders and meet legal obligations. You may ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time — see the data deletion page.
We may update this policy; the last-updated date appears at the top.

legal.deletionLead: You can ask HATTAH to delete your personal data at any time.
deletionSteps: Send an email to hattah.store.co@gmail.com with the subject “Data deletion request”.
Include your name and the phone number you used when ordering on WhatsApp so we can verify it is you.
We will confirm receipt, delete the data we hold about you and tell you when it is done, within 30 days at most.
You can also send the same request on WhatsApp at +90 552 998 71 12.
legal.deletionNote: The site has no user accounts, so the data we hold is only the order details you sent us on WhatsApp. Some records may be kept where the law requires it.
